validationScope: Format, source-key and exact-quotation checks only; this is not semantic validation.

checks.name: two-string response preserves every prose word and explicit citation when splitting headings
standard JSON fence is accepted without content repair
32 known paragraph keys are accepted; 33 are rejected
an uncited opening is rejected even when the next section is cited
one cited opening cannot authorize a second uncited opening paragraph
an unknown source key is rejected rather than repaired
a fabricated quotation is rejected despite a valid source key
a heading-first answer is accepted with an empty lead and cited nonempty section
all-empty or all-blank answer is rejected; empty section never substitutes for prose
a heading with no body is rejected
citations in headings are rejected
duplicate headings are rejected
third-level Markdown heading cannot masquerade as cited prose
heading with attached prose cannot masquerade as a normal paragraph
optional-heading prose-only response matches the written prompt contract
extra JSON fields are rejected
HTML and external links remain prohibited
only a nonmatching final period or comma moves outside every supported quote delimiter
an exact quote keeps its punctuation and needs no normalization
a full exact match in any cited source wins over punctuation normalization
punctuation normalization cannot authorize invented words, other punctuation or uncited sources
multiple quotation moves preserve paragraphs, apostrophes, words and citation positions
